messages:
Rae (eng-platform): flagging an oddity: p50 stable, p95 spiky, p99 unchanged for /v1/embeddings on the latency dashboard. Users flagged it in #support.
Tom (console): can you screenshot? Also which aggregation mode is the chart using?
Rae (eng-platform): screenshot here: https://console.redwood.internal/img/emb-pctl.png. It shows p95 jump at 11:14. Chart metadata: aggregation=histogram for that window.
Isha (telemetry): histogram interpolation can overshoot mid-tail if bucket boundaries align with a small cluster of fallback latencies. Any recent routing changes?
Diego (backend): We enabled a soft-quota fallback last night for burst protection, routes some requests to a pooled instance. That pool has slightly higher 95th percentile.
Tom (console): mixing two distributions can produce non-monotonic looking quantile series if the UI swaps between histogram and tdigest paths within the same view. We should show which mode is active.
Rae (eng-platform): quick debug: raw sample counts around the spike are low (~450), and fallback-tagged samples ~90. So small addition could move p95 a lot.
Isha (telemetry): action items: 1) Emit telemetry when aggregation-mode switches mid-window. 2) Tag sketches with route_variant before merging so we can break down at query time.
Diego (backend): I'll ensure fallback writes include route_variant=fallback. Also will add a server-side path that prefers rehydrated raw samples for final pctl if total N>2000.
Tom (console): UI quick wins: add "aggregation mode" pill and per-quantile sample counts in tooltip. Add a subtle "low sample" badge under 1k. I'll PR to staging.
Rae (eng-platform): pls also add a small banner in the dashboard: "Percentiles sensitive to low sample counts and mixed-route fallbacks."
deploy-bot: ci passed for tom/agg-pill PR #4129; staging deploy scheduled.
Isha (telemetry): I'll add an alert rule for "mixed-aggregation && sample_count < 1000" so SRE gets a heads-up before customers notice.
Tom (console): deployed to staging, monitoring.
Rae (eng-platform): thanks team. Once staging confirms, let's add a line in the incident-runbook about interpreting p95 spikes when fallbacks are active.
Diego (backend): noted, creating small deploy to ensure variant tags are present.
